## QA Engineer Review

The change updates `tests/integration/test_lists/waives.txt` with a waiver for the GPTOSS four-GPU W4 test using v1 KV cache, DP4, Triton, and automatic configuration. The waiver references `nvbugs/6762289`. Coverage is insufficient for this case until the underlying failure is resolved.
